title: Effective half-life in the body
caption: A tracer leaves the body by decay (T_phys = 6 h) and by excretion (T_bio = 3 h) at once, so the rates add: 1/T_eff = 1/6 + 1/3, T_eff = 2 h. Of 600 MBq given, 150 MBq remains after 4 h, two effective half-lives.
alt: Activity in the body against time: physical decay alone falling slowly, biological clearance alone falling faster, and the effective curve falling fastest, with 150 megabecquerels at 4 hours.
description: Starting from 600 MBq: 300 MBq at 2 h, 150 MBq at 4 h.

checks.name: decay and clearance together halve the activity in 2 h
